features.title: Review a thread workspace's changes as one all-files surface
features.summary: Read the current thread workspace's jj diff against its base bookmark and show every changed file in one stacked review, grouped with pulls.review's deterministic scopes, with a searchable file rail, per-file lazy comparisons and persisted viewed progress. The same grouping is available as the /pulls command in a thread and the pulls_review agent tool.
failureModes: A missing workspace, a workspace without a jj repository, no resolvable base bookmark, or a missing jj binary is reported with its own reason instead of an empty diff.
jj stderr never reaches the client; a failed command is classified, not quoted.
A patch larger than the Host cap, or one with more files than one message carries, is flagged as truncated and clipped rather than silently shortened or rejected.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the resolved thread workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The e2e journey provisions a disposable jj repository; unit tests inject a scripted jj runner and check the real CLI output separately.

reach: expect textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions"
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "/pulls"

features.title: Summarize review scopes with the thread's own model
features.summary: One model call over the whole diff turns the deterministic scope summaries into short one-line-per-scope prose, using the provider the thread last requested with and the first model that provider offers.
failureModes: No thread provider, no offered model, or no Host llm service is reported as its own reason, never as an empty summary.
A review that failed, or a workspace with no changes, keeps its own reason instead of blaming the model.
An answer without a usable `key: text` line leaves the deterministic summaries in place.
An explicit provider/model from the caller wins over the thread route.

externalDependencies.boundary: The DSH llm service and the provider route the thread's session log records.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Unit tests inject a scripted complete() and route sources; the scratch profile has no provider, so its UI path can only be reached with a configured account.

reach: expect text "No model route is available for this thread*"

verification.testName: reads one keyed line per scope
uses the thread provider with the first model it offers, and lends it the session id
reports no route when neither the caller nor the thread names a provider
reports an unusable answer instead of inventing summaries

verification.reason: A *successful* summary needs a configured provider account and the scratch/e2e profiles have none, so no browser journey can drive one. The failure footer is asserted by the catalog reach, and the route, protocol and failure paths by unit tests.

features.title: Track viewed progress per file
features.summary: Each file header and rail row marks its file viewed, the header menu marks every file viewed, clears them or jumps to the next unviewed file, and auto-mark on scroll (on by default, a setting) marks a file once its header leaves the review viewport. A turn review writes the Host's diff-viewed marks; a workspace review writes its local record.
failureModes: A Host that does not serve the idempotent diff-viewed mark disables auto-mark and leaves the manual toggle working.
Auto-mark only ever marks, so scrolling back never unviews a file the reviewer marked.
A workspace review starts fresh when its revision changes, so a mark cannot outlive the diff it reviewed.

verification.testName: marks and unmarks a batch without duplicating or dropping other paths

features.title: Open every changed file in one review tab
features.summary: The plugin writes the changes-review tab kind itself, so a changed-files card row or a prose file link opens an all-files review instead of the native one-file tab: a source switch between the turn snapshot and the live workspace diff, every file stacked with its comparison mounted only near the viewport, unified/split and wrap choices, and the native tab reachable again from the classicReviewTab setting.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; live. Turns the all-files tab takeover off so the native one-file tab opens.

failureModes: A DSH release that changes the changes-review address stops matching, so the native tab resumes instead of the plugin breaking the open path.
A turn whose summary the Host no longer serves reports its own empty or failed state and offers Retry.
A comparison the Host refuses (binary, oversized, missing) renders one line instead of an empty diff.
reach: expect text "File created in this review.*"

verification.testName: reads and writes the changes-review address

verification.reason: A turn with changed files needs a model provider turn; the scratch and e2e profiles run none. The workspace path of the same surface is covered by the scopes and progress reaches.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the tab reads the Host routes and plugin APIs it already covers; it starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Comment on reviewed lines
features.summary: Hover a changed line to anchor a comment thread, reply, resolve or reopen it, and delete it behind a confirmation. Threads live in Host storage keyed by the review identity, so the Agent reads and writes the same threads through review_comments and review_comment_* tools.
failureModes: A Host that does not serve the comments API hides the affordances instead of failing the review.
A thread that no longer exists is refused by its id rather than invented.
Deleting a thread needs an explicit confirm and removes its replies with it.

verification.testName: a comment thread belongs to one review and keeps its anchor
a reply, a resolve and a reopen keep the thread and its author
an unknown thread is refused instead of invented

verification.reason: Reaching a line affordance needs a comparison in a turn or workspace review; the scratch and e2e profiles cannot produce one with a provider. The Host store and API are covered by unit tests and the API contract by the catalog checks.
